name: Create a Board
description: Create a new Trello board or copy from an existing one. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-boards/#api-boards-post).

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The new name for the board. 1 to 16384 characters long.

configurable_props.name: defaultLabels
configurable_props.label: Default Labels
configurable_props.description: Determines whether to use the default set of labels.

configurable_props.name: defaultLists
configurable_props.label: Default Lists
configurable_props.description: Determines whether to add the default set of lists to a board (To Do, Doing, Done). It is ignored if idBoardSource is provided.

configurable_props.name: desc
configurable_props.label: Description
configurable_props.description: A new description for the board, 0 to 16384 characters long

configurable_props.name: idOrganization
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: The id or name of the team the board should belong to.

configurable_props.name: idBoardSource
configurable_props.label: Board Source ID
configurable_props.description: The id of a board to copy into the new board.

configurable_props.name: keepFromSource
configurable_props.label: Keep From Source
configurable_props.description: To keep cards from the original board pass in the value `cards`.

configurable_props.name: powerUps
configurable_props.label: Power-Ups
configurable_props.description: The Power-Ups that should be enabled on the new board. One of: `all`, `calendar`, `cardAging`, `recap`, `voting`.

configurable_props.name: prefsPermissionLevel
configurable_props.description: The permissions level of the board. One of: org, private, public.
configurable_props.label: Prefs Permission Level

configurable_props.name: prefsVoting
configurable_props.label: Prefs Voting
configurable_props.description: Who can vote on this board. One of disabled, members, observers, org, public.

configurable_props.name: prefsComments
configurable_props.label: Prefs Comments
configurable_props.description: Who can comment on cards on this board. One of: disabled, members, observers, org, public.

configurable_props.name: prefsInvitations
configurable_props.label: Prefs Invitations
configurable_props.description: Determines what types of members can invite users to join. One of: admins, members.

configurable_props.name: prefsSelfJoin
configurable_props.label: Prefs Self Join
configurable_props.description: Determines whether users can join the boards themselves or whether they have to be invited.

configurable_props.name: prefsCardCovers
configurable_props.label: Prefs Card Covers
configurable_props.description: Determines whether card covers are enabled.

configurable_props.name: prefsBackground
configurable_props.label: Prefs Background
configurable_props.description: The id of a custom background or one of: `blue`, `orange`, `green`, `red`, `purple`, `pink`, `lime`, `sky`, `grey`.

configurable_props.name: prefsCardAging
configurable_props.label: Prefs Card Aging
configurable_props.description: Determines the type of card aging that should take place on the board if card aging is enabled. One of: pirate, regular.
